text:
Indoor lab scene against a white wall. Left foreground: a white instrument with a grey/blue base and flat top plate (balance or stirrer), holding a small white rack with two tubes — one capped with a red screw cap, one uncapped and clear/empty. A white pole and black cable run down the wall behind it.

Centre: a grey metal bench-top platform on legs. On it sits a dark tube rack with multiple round wells; one upright tube with an orange cap stands in a well, the other wells appear empty. A white label with a black-and-white marker pattern is attached to the rack. A teal-and-white label strip lies on the platform edge.

Right: a white rectangular benchtop device with a round dial on its sloped top. Window and daylight below right.
